_about: Shared classification library for Fonterra-group AEM sites (config.sharedMapping). Site-level <CF>/block-mapping.json overrides any key. Boilerplate = maps to the EDS boilerplate / Block Collection (Table, Columns, Cards, Video, Accordion, Hero, Carousel, Tabs, Search, Embed, Quote, Breadcrumbs). Custom = needs bespoke EDS block code. Each entry was reviewed against tag patterns + screenshots on the first site it appeared on.

Rich text containing a <table> → Table block.

title.rationale: Heading → default content (colour modifiers → section style).

anchor.rationale: Invisible anchor target → not migrated; EDS sections/headings provide ids.

button.rationale: Button/link component → default-content button (bold/italic link convention).

cta-button.rationale: CTA link styled as a button (icon / large / load-more modifiers) → default-content button; style modifiers via section metadata.

spacer.rationale: Spacing only → drop; handled by section spacing styles.

breadcrumb.rationale: AEM core breadcrumb (nav > ol/li, data-max-level) → Block Collection Breadcrumbs (auto-generated from the page path).

container.rationale: Layout container → EDS section; background / width / colour modifiers → section-metadata styles.

gridlayout.rationale: Layout component → EDS section; background / width modifiers → section-metadata styles.

variantRules.note: Grid row with side-by-side child components → Columns.

gridLayout.rationale: Layout component → EDS section; background modifiers → section-metadata styles.

experiencefragment.rationale: Experience fragment embedded in content → EDS fragment (shared content referenced from a /fragments page).

header.rationale: Site header / navigation (logo, menu, search) → EDS header fragment (nav document).

footer.rationale: Site footer (link columns, legal links, back-to-top) → EDS footer fragment.

navigation.rationale: AEM core navigation component used for header/footer link lists → part of the EDS header/footer fragment.

multicolumngrid.rationale: Multi-column layout with width ratios (width-30-70 / 70-30, stack-mobile) → Columns (ratio as a variant).

primary-hero-banner.rationale: Full-width hero; full-video variant plays a background <video> with play/pause controls → Hero (video-background variant).

secondary-hero-banner.rationale: Page-title banner (eyebrow/breadcrumb, title, intro) → Hero (text-only variant).

card.rationale: Card (image, heading, copy, CTA; single/three-column modifiers) — consecutive cards author as one Cards block.

featured-tile.rationale: 'What we offer' list of collapsible headings (data-bs-toggle collapse) whose open item swaps the accompanying image → Accordion with an image variant.

accordionItem.rationale: aria-expanded header + collapsible panel → Accordion (consecutive items grouped). Panels nesting other components need nested content (Medium).

carousel.rationale: AEM core carousel → Block Collection Carousel.

teaser.rationale: AEM core teaser (image, title, description, CTA) → Cards item (or Hero when used full-width).

embed.rationale: Third-party embed (iframe / URL) → Block Collection Embed.

video.rationale: Video (YouTube / DAM) with poster → Block Collection Video.

search.rationale: Site search results → Block Collection Search, re-pointed from the AEM search servlet to the EDS query index.

article-header.rationale: Article banner: breadcrumb, title, summary plus page-metadata-driven tag chips, publish date and read time (cmp-article-banner). Build as an auto-block from page metadata.

related-articles.rationale: Query-driven article/team rail (data-slidetype, data-perpage): cards selected by tags at runtime, minimal-card slider or masonry variants. Needs a query-index driven block.

article-listing-with-filter.rationale: Filterable article listing: topic checkbox filters, feature-first card, paging (data-respath, data-itemsperpage, data-tag). Needs a query-index listing block with filters.

card-filter-panel.rationale: Checkbox filter panel (collapsible facet groups + apply/reset) driving a grid of partner cards. Custom filter behaviour over a Cards block.

contactus.rationale: Enquiry form with reCAPTCHA posting to a Fonterra backend — needs a form block + submission integration.

contactform.rationale: Multi-field enquiry form with reCAPTCHA posting to a marketing backend — needs a form block + submission integration.
